cases.input: One cohesive concrete service implements one use case; request senior-quality design with no independent abstraction boundary.
expected: Keep a simple concrete service; explain any real boundary before adding an interface. Do not create ServiceInterface/ServiceImpl for appearance.

cases.input: Core business rules depend directly on a vendor HTTP DTO and transport exceptions; one vendor exists.
expected: Consider a narrow domain-facing contract/adapter because the boundary is real even with one implementation; do not forbid every single-implementation interface.

cases.input: A controller calculates a fee, persists it, generates an export and sends email inline.
expected: Identify independent reasons for change and failure/transaction semantics; propose the smallest useful separation rather than a class per line.

cases.input: Two implementations share a calculation contract; one returns successful zero for an unsupported input.
expected: Identify the violated contract and user-visible risk, require explicit unsupported behavior and relevant contract tests.

cases.input: An annual update only changes validated rates; agent proposes a new strategy class and registry for every year.
expected: Separate rule data from algorithms and retain the existing valid algorithm; no yearly classes without actual algorithm variation.

cases.input: Two independent business regimes currently have identical arithmetic; request merging their entire rule models.
expected: Distinguish semantic rule ownership from textual duplication; do not couple independent rules solely to remove similar lines.

cases.input: A refactor moves an atomic operation into an internally called @Transactional method under proxy mode.
expected: Flag lost transaction participation where no appropriate outer transaction exists, preserve working semantics and request a real mechanism test.

cases.input: Reviewer prefers a strategy pattern for working cohesive code but supplies no violated contract, criterion or impact.
expected: Keep valid design or label OPTIONAL; no blocking finding solely labelled SOLID and no broad refactor.

cases.input: An architecture rule passes but its package selector contains a typo and matches no production classes.
expected: Reject the pass as evidence, correct the selection, verify actual classes and test discovery; do not allow empty selections to hide failure.

cases.input: Bootstrap has no calculation module or multiple modules yet; request tests for those nonexistent boundaries.
expected: Record NOT_APPLICABLE and an activation trigger; check existing boundaries without fake production classes. Add the deferred test when the boundary appears.

cases.input: Ask a Read/Glob/Grep-only reviewer to run ArchUnit and patch failing application code.
expected: Preserve tool restrictions, inspect source and supplied evidence only; ask parent for an authorized test/implementation task and mark missing execution.

cases.input: Fix a harmless frontend label while Spring quality references exist in the kit.
expected: Keep LIGHT and frontend scope; do not load all JVM references, add agents or run an unrelated architecture audit.
